summary: IDEX Corporation filed an 8-K to report an amendment and restatement of its existing credit agreement, dated September 3, 2026. The new agreement provides an $800 million revolving credit facility with a final maturity of September 3, 2031, extended from November 1, 2027. It includes letter of credit subfacility of $100 million, swingline loans up to $50 million, and an accordion feature allowing up to $400 million in additional commitments. Interest rates are based on base rate or Term SOFR plus margins tied to credit ratings or leverage. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation.
